Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser

Class BookmarkStore

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.BookmarkStore
public final class BookmarkStore extends Object
The in-memory bookmark collection: add / edit / remove / list plus folder and URL lookups. It performs no file I/O — BrowserStore loads the list this holds and saves it back, which keeps the collection logic free of AWT, JavaFX and the filesystem so it unit-tests headless.

Bookmarks are keyed by their stable Bookmark.getId(); adding a bookmark whose URL already exists updates that entry rather than creating a duplicate, so "bookmark this page" twice is idempotent.

    • add

      public Bookmark add(Bookmark bookmark, boolean keepFolder)
      Adds a bookmark. When one with the same non-blank URL already exists it is updated in place (title/folder refreshed) instead of duplicated.
      Parameters:
      bookmark - the bookmark to store (null is ignored)
      keepFolder - when true and the URL already exists, retain the existing folder instead of overwriting it
      Returns:
      the stored bookmark, or null when bookmark was null or had a blank URL
